database_query.sql: SELECT "r"."region_name" AS "地区", "o"."metric_id" AS "指标ID", "i"."metric_name" AS "指标名称", "o"."value" AS "数值", "o"."unit" AS "单位", "o"."population_type" AS "人口口径", "o"."year" AS "年份" FROM "main"."public_observations" AS "o" JOIN "main"."public_regions" AS "r" ON "o"."region_id" = "r"."region_id" JOIN "main"."public_indicators" AS "i" ON "o"."metric_id" = "i"."metric_id" WHERE "o"."year" = 2024 AND "o"."region_id" IN ('huainan', 'xinjin', 'shijingshan') AND "o"."metric_id" IN ('population_resident', 'population_registered', 'population_nonlocal') ORDER BY "r"."region_name", "o"."metric_id" LIMIT 201
